title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 25: praise for Yahweh's wonderful things, the feast on the mountain, and death swallowed up forever.

questions.text: Why does the speaker say he will exalt Yahweh and praise his name?
questions.explanation: The speaker praises Yahweh because he has done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

answers.text: Because Yahweh has given him a long life
Because Yahweh has defeated his personal enemies
Because Yahweh has done wonderful things, planned long ago
Because Yahweh has made him a king

questions.text: What has Yahweh done to the fortified city?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has made a city into a heap and a fortified city into a ruin; it will never be built.

answers.text: He has enlarged its walls and towers
He has made it a ruin that will never be built
He has filled it with his own people
He has given it to the poor and needy

questions.text: To whom has Yahweh been a stronghold?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has been a stronghold to the poor and to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm and a shade from the heat.

answers.text: To the poor and the needy
To the kings of the earth
To the strangers
To the dreaded ones

questions.text: What will Yahweh of Armies make for all peoples in this mountain?
questions.explanation: In this mountain Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat and of well refined choice wines.

answers.text: A new covenant with all the nations
A place of judgment for the kings
A great army out of all the peoples
A feast of choice meat and choice wines

questions.text: What will Yahweh destroy in this mountain?
questions.explanation: He will destroy the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

answers.text: The altars of the nations round about
The covering and the veil spread over all nations
The weapons of war of all the peoples
The thrones of the kings of the earth

questions.text: What has he swallowed up forever?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:8 says he has swallowed up death forever, and the Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces.

answers.text: Death
The sea
The nations
Sorrow and sighing

questions.text: What will the Lord Yahweh wipe away from off all faces?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces and take away the reproach of his people from all the earth.

answers.text: Shame
Sweat
Tears
Dust

questions.text: What will be said in that day about God?
questions.explanation: In that day it will be said, "Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us!"

answers.text: "The battle belongs to Yahweh, and he will give us the victory!"
"Holy, holy, holy is Yahweh; the whole earth is full of his glory!"
"Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God!"
"Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us!"

questions.text: Which nation will be trodden down in his place like straw in the water of the dunghill?
questions.explanation: Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

answers.text: Moab
Egypt
Assyria
Edom

questions.text: What has Yahweh done to the high fortress of your walls?
questions.explanation: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

answers.text: He has strengthened it against enemies
He has set watchmen on it
He has brought it down to the dust
He has covered it with gold
